activeAdultUseRetailStoresSource: OCP 2025 Annual Report (December 31, 2025): retail-store line of the 343 total active adult-use establishments (retail + cultivator + mfg + testing). Refreshed annually when the OCP publishes its annual report.
activeAdultUseMunicipalitiesSource: OCP 2025 Annual Report; matches the AU retail license spread across 65 unique host municipalities. Refreshed annually.

currentOcpLicenseeRoster.source: OCP Adult-Use Establishments CSV via scripts/ocp/fetch-ocp-towns.py (live deduped Store-type count)
currentOcpLicenseeRoster.note: Two parallel facts are intentional. The 187 figure on stat cards is the Annual-Report total of active AU retail-store establishments and is preserved as 'state of the market in 2025'. The 107 figure below is the live OCP licensee-search CSV deduped Store-type count for today, and is what /find-a-dispensary and the OCP-tracker use to drive per-city cards. These should NOT be conflated; both refresh on the schedule documented in nextRefresh.

dataSource: OCP 2025 Annual Report (anchors stat-card facts) + OCP Adult-Use Establishments CSV fetched 2026-07-08 (anchors per-store live facts).
nextRefresh: Annual-Report fields (top-level activeAdultUse*): refresh when OCP publishes its annual report (typically Q1 the following year). OCP-CSV fields (currentOcpLicenseeRoster.*): monthly via `node apps/maine-cannabis/scripts/ocp/refresh-site-stats.cjs` when OCP publishes new CSVs.
notes: Single source of truth for stat-card numbers across the site (404.html, index.astro, market.astro, etc.). Run `node scripts/ocp/refresh-site-stats.cjs` after each monthly OCP update to refresh these values. Update all consumers at once.
